name: RSI Expert v2.0
summary: This EA trades RSI overbought/oversold reversals, opening buy positions when RSI dips below a configurable oversold threshold and sell positions when RSI rises above an overbought threshold. It includes basic stop-loss and take-profit management along with position sizing controls. The strategy targets mean-reversion opportunities on trending or ranging markets where RSI extremes signal potential price reversals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于RSI超买超卖信号进行均值回归交易，当RSI跌破可配置的超卖阈值时开多仓，当RSI升破超买阈值时开空仓。EA包含基本的止损止盈管理和仓位控制功能，旨在捕捉RSI极端值预示的价格反转机会。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于RSI指标的均值回归原理，认为当RSI进入超买或超卖区域后价格有回归均值的倾向。入场条件为RSI跌破超卖阈值时做多、升破超买阈值时做空，属于典型的逆势交易策略。出场条件依赖固定点数的止损和止盈设定，未见到移动止损或动态出场的机制。仓位管理使用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式，缺乏根据市场波动率调整仓位的自适应机制。资金管理方面仅依靠止损设定控制单笔风险，未实现多笔交易间的总体风险控制或最大回撤限制。策略在强趋势市场中容易遭遇连续亏损，因为RSI可能长期停留在超买或超卖区域而不发生回归。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is grounded in mean reversion principles of the RSI indicator, assuming that prices tend to revert to the mean after RSI reaches extreme overbought or oversold levels. Entry conditions trigger a buy when RSI falls below the oversold threshold and a sell when RSI rises above the overbought threshold, representing a classic counter-trend trading approach. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels in points, with no trailing stop or dynamic exit mechanism observed. Position sizing uses either a fixed lot size or a balance-based percentage calculation, lacking adaptive sizing based on market volatility such as ATR. Money management is limited to per-trade risk control via stop-loss, without portfolio-level risk controls or maximum drawdown limits. The strategy is vulnerable to consecutive losses in strong trending markets where RSI can remain in overbought or oversold zones for extended periods without reverting.

parameters.name: Magic_Number
parameters.description: EA魔幻编号用于标识订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

pros: 策略逻辑简单明了，基于经典RSI超买超卖反转信号，易于理解和验证
包含止损止盈设置，具备基本的风险控制框架
使用魔幻编号管理订单，避免与其他EA冲突
参数可配置性强，用户可根据不同品种和市场环境灵活调整
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, based on the classic RSI overbought/oversold reversal signals that are easy to understand and verify
Includes stop-loss and take-profit settings providing a basic risk control framework
Uses a magic number for order management to avoid conflicts with other EAs
Highly configurable parameters allow users to adjust flexibly for different instruments and market conditions
cons: 缺乏新K线检测机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓导致过度交易
无移动止损功能，盈利头寸在价格回撤时可能损失已获利润
均值回归策略在强趋势行情中容易连续亏损
未包含点差过滤，在宽点差环境下交易成本可能侵蚀利润
缺少总体仓位和最大回撤控制，多笔亏损可能造成较大资金损失
cons_en: Lacks new bar detection, potentially opening multiple positions on the same bar leading to overtrading
No trailing stop functionality, profitable positions may give back gains during price retracements
Mean reversion strategy is prone to consecutive losses in strong trending markets
No spread filter included, trading costs in wide-spread environments may erode profits
Missing overall position and maximum drawdown controls, multiple losing trades could cause significant capital loss
improvements: 增加新K线检测机制，确保每根K线只执行一次交易信号避免重复开仓
添加移动止损功能锁定浮盈，并根据ATR动态调整止损止盈距离
增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向），在趋势方向一致时才开仓以提高胜率
实现基于账户权益和最大回撤的整体资金管理机制
improvements_en: Add new bar detection to ensure trading signals execute only once per bar and prevent duplicate entries
Implement trailing stop to lock in floating profits and use ATR-based dynamic stop-loss/take-profit distances
Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction) to only enter trades aligned with the prevailing trend for higher win rate
Implement portfolio-level money management based on account equity and maximum drawdown limits

risk_points: 缺少新K线检测可能导致同根K线重复开仓增加风险敞口
均值回归策略在趋势行情中可能产生连续亏损
无点差过滤在高成本环境下可能不利
止损为固定点数未考虑市场波动率变化
risk_points_en: Missing new bar detection may cause duplicate entries on the same bar increasing risk exposure
Mean reversion strategy can produce consecutive losses in trending markets
No spread filter may be detrimental in high-cost trading environments
Fixed-point stop-loss does not account for changes in market volatility
